scope.description: Local PrepareReply producer and lossless byte-transport contract, including nonzero accepted-value ballots.
assumptions: The receiver decodes the complete byte stream emitted by SendMsg into a fresh PrepareReply, as the normal receive loop does.
The observed producer instance is not concurrently modified during handlePrepare and byte decoding.
excluded: No quorum decision, state-machine application or end-to-end progress consequence is asserted.
No claim about startup, timer-triggered recovery, durability or crash restart.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Replace constructor startup and TCP sockets with constructor-equivalent empty protocol containers and separate per-link byte buffers.
Call private handlers synchronously; no event loop, timer, execution worker or crash is modeled.
Reduce instance arrays to four entries; only instance 1.0 is touched. No produced instance field or message is edited.
Hold the PreAcceptReply and unused Prepare bytes without delivering them.

plan_uncertainties: No decision or application endpoint is observed; loss of this field is not alone proof of a consensus safety violation.
The constructor/event-loop/timer bypass is explicit; local codec applicability is grounded independently in the producer/receiver contract.
